summary: Located in the sought-after village of Colburn, this beautifully maintained first floor apartment is ideally suited to a wide range of buyers, from professionals and retirees to buy-to-let investors looking for a ready-to-go purchase. Currently tenanted making an ideal ready made investment also.
description:
Situated within close proximity to Catterick Garrison, a thriving military town with a wide selection of shops, supermarkets, gyms, eateries, and essential services, the location is as practical as it is desirable. The property is also just a short drive - approximately three miles south - from the picturesque and historic market town of Richmond, North Yorkshire. Here, residents and visitors enjoy scenic riverside walks, the iconic Richmond Castle, charming independent boutiques, and a vibrant market square, all steeped in rich heritage. Tucked away in a quiet and well-kept development, the apartment benefits from a secure communal entrance and offers bright, thoughtfully planned accommodation that briefly comprises of a welcoming entrance hall, generously sized lounge ideal for relaxing or entertaining, kitchen with modern units and space for appliances, two well-proportioned bedrooms, including a spacious double and a family bathroom with three piece suite. Externally, the property enjoys immaculately kept communal garden areas that enhance its peaceful setting, along with the convenience of an allocated parking space. Whether you're looking to invest, downsize, or simply settle into a low-maintenance home in a fantastic location, this property ticks all the boxes. Early viewing is strongly advised to appreciate the full potential and charm of what's on offer

ENTRANCE HALL A welcoming entrance hallway providing a practical introduction to the apartment. The hallway benefits from a radiator, an intercom entry system for added convenience and security, and provides access to all principal rooms, creating a well-designed and functional layout throughout the property.

LOUNGE A spacious and inviting principal reception room, offering an excellent space for both everyday living and entertaining. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window floods the room with natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere whilst enhancing the generous proportions of the space. The lounge provides ample room for a range of lounge furniture, allowing flexibility in layout to suit individual tastes and requirements. A wall mounted electric heater completes this comfortable and well-proportioned living area.

KITCHEN/BREAKFAST ROOM The well-appointed kitchen/breakfast room is thoughtfully designed to provide both practicality and a welcoming space for everyday dining. Fitted with a modern range of base and wall units, the kitchen is complemented by laminate work surfaces and incorporates an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap. Integrated appliances include an oven, hob and overhead stainless steel chimney-style extractor, together with an integrated fridge and freezer. There is also plumbing for an automatic washing machine, ensuring the room is well equipped for modern living. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows an abundance of natural light to fill the room, creating a bright and pleasant atmosphere. The breakfast area offers ample space for a dining table and chairs, making it ideal for informal family meals or entertaining guests. There is also sufficient room to incorporate a breakfast bar or dresser, allowing a new owner to personalise the space to suit their lifestyle. A wall-mounted electric heater provides additional comfort, completing this spacious and versatile kitchen/breakfast room.

BEDROOM ONE A generously proportioned double bedroom, offering an excellent amount of space for a full range of bedroom furniture and furnishings. The room is enhanced by a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, allowing natural light to flood the space and creating a bright and airy atmosphere. The generous proportions provide flexibility for additional furniture, making this a comfortable and relaxing principal bedroom. A wall-mounted electric heater provides warmth and comfort, completing this spacious and well-presented room.

BEDROOM TWO A further generously proportioned double bedroom, offering comfortable and versatile accommodation with ample space for a range of bedroom furniture and furnishings. The room benefits from a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, allowing natural light to create a bright and welcoming atmosphere. A wall-mounted electric heater provides warmth and comfort, making this an ideal guest bedroom, second double bedroom or home office, depending on the requirements of the new owner.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is appointed with a contemporary white suite, creating a modern space designed for everyday comfort. The suite comprises of panel bath, complemented by a wash hand basin, together with a low-level WC. A velux window allows natural light to brighten the room, whilst a radiator provides warmth and comfort.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the development is complemented by well-maintained communal gardens, providing attractive outdoor surroundings for residents to enjoy. The property also benefits from an allocated parking space, offering the convenience of secure off-road parking. The combination of pleasant communal grounds and dedicated parking further enhances the appeal of this well-presented home, making it an excellent choice for a variety of buyers, including first-time purchasers, professionals and those looking to downsize.
